notes.title: Abglantz Demo Update 2025.1 !
notes.notes:
Another big Abglantz Demo Update is finally here!  Version 2025.1.

Too many changes to list...



some highlights: 

- lots of user experience improvements (gui, sound, etc.)

- some visual improvements (maps, effects)

- gibs cause blood effects

- option to keep decals permanently (even saved)

- fixed a bad bug that could resize menus to zero

- new headshot system (certain weapons only, try the minigun)

- much more

notes.title: Abglantz Demo update!
notes.notes:
A big Abglantz Demo update is finally here!

too many changes to list...

some highlights:
- three new maps in the demo (including tutorial)
- drastically improved performance
- many additional options
- many improvements to maps, models and gameplay
- improved ai
- fixed a very problematic sound file (thx sjellos)
- much more

this took a while, thank you for your patience...
